In a world that’s always chasing the next new thing—faster, flashier, more—I longed to create something fundamentally different: a brand that values patience, purpose, and personality as much as beauty. That’s how Mir Kash began.

Two years and countless sketches, samples, and soulful conversations later, I’m immensely grateful for the community that has grown around Mir Kash. We’re a small but passionate group of individuals who care deeply about quality, meaning, and mindful living. We don’t flood the world with endless products—instead, we obsess over the details and perfect a few pieces each year, because I truly believe the simplest things are the hardest to get just right.

From day one, Mir Kash has been self-funded and independent. This freedom lets us move at our own rhythm and stay true to our values, ensuring every decision echoes our commitment to sustainability and integrity. My hope has always been to create bags and accessories for those who genuinely connect with our story—pieces that add something thoughtful to your life, and that positively impact every pair of hands, from our craftspeople to you.

Mir Kash is my love letter to dreamers and changemakers. We exist to advocate for an inclusive, responsible, and inspiring future—empowering like-minded souls and brands to choose what truly matters. I hope our designs spark joy and offer beauty you can feel proud to carry.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for joining us and believing in Mir Kash. If you ever want to chat, my inbox is always open, and I love hearing your stories.


With gratitude,
Rajul Daga
Founder, Mir Kash

We will never use animal leather because—

At Mir Kash, style should never come at the cost of animals or the planet. Our timeless, luxury bags are crafted from sustainable, cruelty-free materials like apple, cactus, and microfiber leathers. Made in small batches with meticulous attention to detail, full transparency, and minimal environmental impact, every bag lets you carry your style with pride and conscience."

Mir Kash crafts luxury vegan bags using revolutionary plant-based leathers made from apple peels, cactus leaves, and recycled fibers, delivering waterproof, durable, and ultra-luxe materials that outshine traditional leather without harming the planet. We also innovate with microfiber suede for a rich finish and are actively pioneering new materials like mushroom and banana peel leather, ensuring our collection is always evolving to push the boundaries of sustainable style and uncompromising elegance.
